title: Polynomial Trajectory Planning for Aggressive Quadrotor Flight in Dense Indoor Environments
summary: Plans a geometric path first (RRT*), then fits jointly optimised polynomial segments through it as an unconstrained, numerically stable QP. Removes the need to model the full dynamics in the sampling planner.
key_takeaways: Split planning: kinematic path search => polynomial smoothing
Unconstrained QP formulation stays stable for high polynomial orders
Segment time allocation is the knob that decides feasibility

title: Geometrically Constrained Trajectory Optimization for Multicopters
summary: Introduces MINCO, a minimum-control trajectory class with linear-complexity parameterisation, and GCOPTER, which optimises trajectories inside safe-corridor polytopes with spatial and temporal deformation. Basis of the later ZJU planners.
key_takeaways: MINCO parameterises trajectories by waypoints and durations with linear-time gradients
Constraints become penalties, so a generic unconstrained solver (L-BFGS) works
Year is the arXiv date; journal version not checked here

title: PAMPC: Perception-Aware Model Predictive Control for Quadrotors
summary: Adds perception objectives (keep a point of interest visible, low image-plane velocity) to a quadrotor NMPC cost, so the controller trades tracking accuracy against what the camera sees.
key_takeaways: Perception terms live in the MPC cost, not in a separate planner
Under-actuation means attitude, and so camera pointing, is coupled to translation
Pattern transfers to keeping a nadir camera on matchable terrain

title: Fisher Information Field: an Efficient and Differentiable Map for Perception-aware Planning
summary: Precomputes a voxel map of visual-localisation information so a planner can score any pose quickly and differentiably, instead of reprojecting all landmarks. Shown with RRT* and trajectory optimisation.
key_takeaways: A localisability map turns 'stay localisable' into an ordinary planning cost
Precomputation moves the expensive part out of the planning loop
Same idea works on a 2D grid of terrain or texture informativeness

title: Rapidly-exploring Random Belief Trees for Motion Planning Under Uncertainty
summary: Belief-space planning: grows a tree over state and estimator covariance, propagating a Kalman filter along each edge, so the chosen path respects chance constraints given spatially varying sensing.
key_takeaways: Plan over covariance, not only position
Spatially varying measurement quality is the motivating case, as with TRN or visual fixes
Covariance propagation along candidate edges is cheap enough to do in Python for a 2D demo

title: Perception-aware Planning for Quadrotor Flight in Unknown and Feature-limited Environments
summary: Localisation-aware planner that reasons about which features the camera will see along candidate trajectories and steers yaw and path to keep VIO healthy in sparse-feature scenes (IROS 2025).
key_takeaways: Recent evidence that localisation-aware planning is active research
Couples yaw planning with feature visibility
Code is public under GPL-3.0

title: acados: a modular open-source framework for fast embedded optimal control
summary: Describes acados' structure-exploiting QP and SQP solvers, integrators and code generation for embedded NMPC and MHE.
key_takeaways: Real-time iteration SQP is the default NMPC scheme
Models come from CasADi; C code is generated for the target
Year is the arXiv date

title: TinyMPC: Model-Predictive Control on Resource-Constrained Microcontrollers
summary: ADMM-based MPC solver that caches the Riccati structure so each iteration is cheap enough for a microcontroller; demonstrated on a small quadrotor.
key_takeaways: Convex (linearised) MPC can run on autopilot-class MCUs
Useful 'runs on the aircraft' argument for a product pitch
Repo README cites an ICRA 2024 Best Paper award

title: Data-Driven MPC for Quadrotors
summary: Learns the residual between a nominal quadrotor model and real dynamics with Gaussian processes and uses the corrected model inside acados NMPC, improving tracking at high speed (RA-L 2021).
key_takeaways: Physics model + learned residual beats either alone
Residual mostly captures aerodynamic drag
Template for a propulsion / aero-aware controller

title: Energy Minimization for Wireless Communication with Rotary-Wing UAV
summary: Derives a closed-form propulsion power model for rotary-wing UAVs as a function of forward speed (blade profile, induced and parasite terms), then uses it to optimise trajectories. The power model is widely reused outside the comms context.
key_takeaways: Power vs speed is U-shaped: hover is not the cheapest state per second, and there is a max-range speed
Closed form, so it drops straight into a route cost
Parameters need a real airframe; defaults in the paper are illustrative

title: On Flying Backwards: Preventing Run-away of Small, Low-speed, Fixed-wing UAVs in Strong Winds
summary: Nonlinear lateral path-following guidance for fixed-wing UAVs that uses online wind estimates and adjusts the airspeed reference when wind approaches or exceeds airspeed. Flight-tested in strong mountain winds. This line of work underlies PX4's NPFG.
key_takeaways: Path following must handle wind faster than airspeed explicitly
Wind estimate is a guidance input, so estimator quality matters to guidance
Link between this paper and PX4 NPFG is from the author overlap and PX4 docs naming, not checked line by line

title: Time-optimal Paths for a Dubins airplane
summary: Extends the Dubins car with altitude and bounded climb rate and characterises time-optimal paths with the Pontryagin maximum principle. The base model for most fixed-wing geometric planners.
key_takeaways: Dubins car + altitude = Dubins airplane
Low, medium and high altitude-change cases need different path shapes
No wind in the base model; see EDuPlane for wind

title: Extensions to the Dubins Airplane Method - Flight Performance Constraints in Uniform Wind
summary: Derives closed-form links between flight-performance limits and kinematic constraints, then builds iterative algorithms for 3D fixed-wing trajectories of trochoidal or circular turns and straight segments in uniform wind. Accepted to IEEE TAES per the repo README.
key_takeaways: Trochoids are the wind-correct analogue of Dubins arcs
Climb at constant vertical speed or constant thrust are both handled
Reference code is EDuPlane (Apache-2.0)

title: Safe Low-Altitude Navigation in Steep Terrain With Fixed-Wing Aerial Vehicles
summary: RRT* over Dubins-airplane segments on a DEM with terrain-clearance constraints and guaranteed safe circular loiters, flight-tested on a fixed-wing in the Alps (RA-L vol. 9, no. 5).
key_takeaways: Every planned state keeps a reachable safe loiter circle
DEM in, feasible fixed-wing route out
Open-access status not checked; IEEE DOI may be paywalled

title: PX4 Fixed-wing Altitude/Position Controller Tuning Guide
summary: Official tuning guide for PX4 fixed-wing outer loops: TECS for altitude and airspeed (FW_T_* parameters) and NPFG lateral path following (NPFG_PERIOD and related parameters).
key_takeaways: Tune TECS before NPFG; the guide gives the order
NPFG period and damping set how hard the aircraft converges to the path
Year is the page as fetched, not a release date

title: ArduPlane Navigation Tuning (L1 controller)
summary: How ArduPlane's L1 lateral navigation controller works and how to tune NAVL1_PERIOD and NAVL1_DAMPING for waypoint tracking.
key_takeaways: One period parameter sets aggressiveness of path convergence
Tune roll and pitch loops first
Year is the page as fetched

title: ArduPlane TECS (Total Energy Control System) for Speed and Height Tuning Guide
summary: Explains ArduPlane's TECS: throttle controls total energy, pitch distributes it between height and speed, and how to tune its limits and time constants.
key_takeaways: TECS is energy-based by design, so it is the natural hook for energy-aware guidance
Climb and sink limits must match the real airframe
Year is the page as fetched

title: PX4 ROS 2 Offboard Control Example
summary: Walkthrough of driving PX4 from a ROS 2 node in offboard mode: OffboardControlMode heartbeat, TrajectorySetpoint messages, arming and mode switching via px4_ros_com.
key_takeaways: Offboard needs a continuous OffboardControlMode stream or PX4 falls back
Choose the setpoint level (position, velocity, rates) to match your guidance layer
This is the integration point for a custom MPC or trajectory tracker

title: UIUC Propeller Data Site
authors: Michael Selig and UIUC Applied Aerodynamics Group
summary: Wind-tunnel measurements of thrust and power coefficients vs advance ratio for many small UAV propellers, plus geometry.
key_takeaways: Real propeller curves instead of guessed efficiency
Enough to build a thrust / power map for an energy-aware planner
Check the site's terms before redistributing data in a product

title: Small Unmanned Aircraft: Theory and Practice
summary: Textbook covering fixed-wing dynamics, autopilot design, state estimation, straight-line and orbit path following, Dubins path management and path planning. The repo README links a draft second edition PDF and chapter slides.
key_takeaways: Chapters 10-12 are the guidance and planning core
Draft second edition is free via the repo README; the 2012 print edition is Princeton University Press
Pairs with runnable Python project files in the same repo
